context: A boss reviews a policy paper with his deputy
purpose: Teach: 全文/方策/単一/抜本/内外/明示/明白/さらなる

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: この政策文書の全文に目を通したが、提案された方策はどうも具体性に欠けるな。
lines.en: I've read through the entire policy document, but the proposed measures lack specificity.
lines.style: Authoritative boss tone, measured and slightly critical delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: おっしゃる通りです。単一の視点からしか書かれていないので、内外の状況を反映できていません。
lines.en: You're absolutely right. It's written from a single perspective and doesn't reflect domestic and foreign conditions.
lines.style: Respectful deputy tone, agreeing while contributing analytical observation calmly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ここはもう抜本的に書き直す必要があるだろう。中途半端な修正では通用しない。
lines.en: We'll need to fundamentally rewrite this section. Half-measures won't pass muster.
lines.style: Firm decisive boss tone, slightly frustrated but professional throughout.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 承知しました。各部署の責任範囲も明示すべきかと存じます。
lines.en: Understood. I believe we should also explicitly state each department's scope of responsibility.
lines.style: Polite deferential deputy speech, formal business Japanese with suggestion.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: そうだな。財源の問題も明白だし、誰が見ても分かるように書かないと。
lines.en: Indeed. The funding issue is obvious too, and it must be written so anyone can understand.
lines.style: Thoughtful boss tone, slightly softening as agreement is reached.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: では、来週までに改訂版を準備いたします。さらなるご指導をお願いいたします。
lines.en: Then I'll prepare a revised version by next week. I'd appreciate your further guidance.
lines.style: Respectful closing tone, formal humble Japanese with bow-like deference.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 頼んだぞ。月曜の朝一番に私の机に置いておいてくれ。
lines.en: I'm counting on you. Put it on my desk first thing Monday morning.
lines.style: Authoritative but trusting boss tone, concluding the meeting decisively.
